verdict.rationale: Mailgun's own quickstart documents a sandbox domain for sending test email, so the product does provide a first-party test environment. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and says nothing about how the sandbox is isolated from production domains, recipients, logs or analytics. Postman collections and domain-scoped sending keys are adjacent tooling and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the sandbox's isolation from production data, its limits and behavior (e.g. recipient restrictions), whether it is accessible via API/MCP for agent workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Send an email in under two minutes using your sandbox domain
